label: Bible Study
prompt: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put _____ in man.
verse: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in man.
note: Better than any human guarantee — trust placed in the LORD.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the _____ of God, and the communion of the Holy Ghost, be with you all. Amen.
verse: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Ghost, be with you all. Amen.
note: Paul's closing blessing to Corinth names grace, love, and communion in one generous breath.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then there passed by Midianites merchantmen; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmeelites for _____ pieces of silver: and they brought Joseph into Egypt.
verse: Then there passed by Midianites merchantmen; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmeelites for twenty pieces of silver: and they brought Joseph into Egypt.
note: Joseph's price: twenty pieces of silver, paid by traders headed for Egypt — where God was already a step ahead.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Who is like unto thee, O LORD, among the gods? who is like thee, glorious in _____, fearful in praises, doing wonders?
verse: Who is like unto thee, O LORD, among the gods? who is like thee, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?
note: The Song of the Sea: Israel's first worship chorus, sung on a beach still wet from the miracle.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And ye shall hear of wars and _____ of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.
verse: And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.
note: 'Wars and rumours of wars' — British u — 'but the end is not yet.' Jesus' calm on the Mount of Olives.
